meta.title: Cloud sync
meta.description: Syncs your DSH configuration to your own GitHub repository: back up and restore with one click, with scheduled backups (daily / every N minutes / weekly). It also exports a list of installed plugins so a new machine can install them all in one click after restoring. What gets synced is split into Configuration, Application state, and Secrets; the folder inside the repository is configurable and only that subfolder is read or written.
